text:
olivia: Kicking off a follow-up thread from today's all-hands for security/privacy/compliance Qs (SOC2 / ISO / VPC / KMS / audit logs). Panel: @mari (Head of Security), @raj (CTO), @jeff (Product). Post quick Qs and we'll triage + follow up. :lock:

lucas: SOC2 Type II  Do we have a hard delivery window? Customers are asking.

mari: Targeting a Type II report in Q4 2025. Control remediation finished this past quarter; auditor fieldwork is planned for an 8-week window in OctNov. Exact dates dependent on auditor availability. Scope will include Hosted API and Redwood-managed Dedicated.

lucas: What about customer-managed Private deployments  will they be covered?

mari: Private/on-prem is not in our Type II scope (because customers control some controls). We provide a customer evidence package and a "cooperation checklist" so customers can include relevant artifacts in their own audits. For enterprise customers we can provide attestation letters and assist during their audits.

anita: ISO27001 status? Any ETA?

raj: ISO is planned for the next program cycle. We aim to start the ISO program in early 2026 and target certification in H1 2026 if all goes well. We'll reuse SOC2 mappings to accelerate gaps.

jeff: KMS question: can customers use BYOK and rotate keys on their schedule?

mari: Yes. We support three common modes: (1) Redwood-managed keys (default) with quarterly rotation, (2) Customer BYOK via cross-account KMS (you manage key lifecycle and rotations), and (3) HSM-backed keys for on-prem. We recommend envelope encryption to limit exposure of main keys.

lucas: Any example of the minimal KMS policy we ask customers to apply?

mari: Example (minimal cross-account grant snippet):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodEncryptDecrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodKMSAccess" },
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:Encrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

mari: We also publish example CloudFormation/Terraform snippets in the docs for cross-account grants and conditions (e.g., SourceAccount, SourceArn).

jeff: Audit logs  retention and schema? Customers want to tie logs to billing and forensics.

mari: Defaults: Hosted: 400 days retention by default (we settled on this to allow extended inquiry windows), Dedicated: 365 days included (longer retention available as add-on), Private/on-prem: retention controlled by the customer. Export formats: ndjson or parquet to S3, and direct stream to SIEMs (Splunk/Datadog/Elastic).

anita: What fields are included so we can match to billing?

jeff: Logs include request_id, customer_id (redacted for public exports), route, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_ms, region, and decision_reason for fallbacks. We also log a hashed prompt fingerprint for regression tracking (salted hash to avoid storing PII).

lucas: Do you support automated PII redaction before logs leave Redwood?

mari: Yes  optional PII redaction can run in the pipeline. We support deterministic hashing for specific fields and configurable redaction rules that run before export.

security-bot: Reminder: evidence collection owners, please upload control artifacts by 2025-09-30. Use the evidence portal: https://portal.redwood.com/evidence. :rotating_light:

olivia: For Dedicated customers doing BYOK, who do they contact to coordinate networking/VPC-level access?

jeff: Ping @jeff and open a ticket in #eng-infra with the tag "dedicated-byok". We'll schedule a kickoff call and provide a VPC checklist (peering, security groups, endpoint configs).

mari: Follow-ups we'll publish: (1) "Security Starter Pack" with control mappings, KMS BYOK cookbook, VPC checklist, and audit-log schema; (2) How-to examples for exporting logs to S3/SIEM; (3) A short playbook for customers running on-prem for audit readiness. Expect the pack next Monday: https://docs.redwood.com/security/starter-pack (link will be live when published).

anita: Any exceptions for regulated customers who need >5 yrs retention?

mari: For hosted we can discuss custom retention SLAs with Sales/Legal and add long-term archival to cold storage. For Dedicated, we offer long-term retention add-ons. For Private, customer handles retention.

lucas: Thanks  who should I cc for the Dedicated KMS ticket?

mari: cc @mari, @jeff, and the assigned Solutions Engineer in your account thread.

olivia: Great thread, thanks everyone. We'll synthesize Qs into the Confluence all-hands notes and follow up on any customer-specific asks. If urgent, DM the account lead + @mari. :thumbsup:
